introduction: Racism is still present in society, in all four corners of the United States, affecting the lives of Black Americans today. History shows us that society has moved forward in a positive way in regards to racism in last 100 years with Brown vs. Board of education, the civil rights movement and Barack Obama being elected President. Yet because racism has evolved into an unspoken feeling it still affects the daily lives of African Americans across the nation. It is also ever present amongst Black Americans themselves due to the misinterpretation of wealth vs. color.
